items.title: Needham remains cautious on Nike stock, sees more downside risk
items.summary: Investing.com -- In a note on Thursday, Needham reiterated its Hold rating on Nike (NYSE: NKE) and cut its earnings estimates ahead of the company's fiscal first-quarter results on Oct. 1 after the close, warning that the stock could keep falling.

items.title: Why Did On Holding Stock Jump If Its Near-Term Guidance Did Not Change?
items.summary: On Holding (ONON) stock rose 7.6% on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, while the S&P 500 finished flat. At its investor day in Zurich, the company unveiled its first share buyback and targets for 2029. What the market bought was a promise to keep choosing price over volume.

items.title: Why Are Sportswear Stocks in a Rut?
items.summary: JD Sports reported falling sales and profits for its fiscal first half today, sending its stock slumping. It’s far from alone. Many players in the sports arena have hit a rough patch, including Adidas and Nike, whose stock prices have fallen by about 15% and more than 44%, respectively, this year.
